notes: RedNet PCIeNX is a PCIe expansion card providing Dante/AES67 networked audio I/O (128x128 channels, expandable to 256x256 via Dante Ready upgrade) to a host computer — it has no analog/digital audio connectors of its own; all audio is carried over the two Ethernet ports. The card is powered entirely from the PCIe slot (bus-powered) — no external power connector is present, so no power port is listed. The two RJ45 ports are Dante Primary and Secondary, supporting redundant or switched network modes; each is rated Gigabit Ethernet (1000BASE-T, Cat5e or better, Cat6 STP preferred) per Focusrite's documentation, hence eth-1g grade. The card itself mounts via a full-height, half-length PCIe 2.1 edge connector (x4 electrical, fits x4–x16 slots); this is an internal card-edge interface rather than a user-facing cable port, so it was omitted from the port list (no matching connector id exists for a PCIe edge connector, and it is not a signal/power cable the installer connects). Sources cross-checked: Focusrite product page, Focusrite User Guide hub, and web aggregation of Focusrite/B&H spec data.
